$comment: Rotation classes, as DATA. Each says what a real corpus change does to the quote digest and to containment. The design claimed the digest survives 'a chunker bump, an ar5iv re-render, a LaTeXML upgrade, an HTML-to-MinerU migration'; these record that only the preamble and whitespace classes actually do, which is why the quote_containment rung exists. See #162 / red team gap 11.

cases.why: An ingest that recovers preamble text and leaves body_text alone -- `ingest-recover-preambles`. The body is untouched, so the digest is untouched. This is the ONE class the design's claim was true of.
